assets.name: hero-correspondence-v01
assets.prompt: Use case: product-mockup / premium editorial still-life. Create one production hero photograph for an intimate private AI studio with a personal-correspondence identity. A beautifully crafted warm ivory cotton-paper envelope, opened just enough to reveal a single blank pale periwinkle-blue note card. A small circular deep ink-blue wax seal lies on the envelope front; seal has an elegant unlettered embossed fold motif, no letters. Envelope centered horizontally, slightly diagonal on a seamless warm matte paper backdrop precisely close to #f5f3ed. View at a refined three-quarter overhead angle, gentle window light from upper left, tactile paper fibres, natural creases, subtle irregular wax, soft realistic contact shadows. Envelope should occupy approximately 70 percent of width and 62 percent of height, with generous clear margins all sides. Quiet, personal, high-end stationery photography, authentic materials, restrained palette warm ivory #f5f3ed and blue #283f83, soft blue note #d5dce9. The image is a standalone object photograph, not a website or UI mockup. No text, no handwriting, no typography, no watermark, no logos, no human hands, no laptop, no coins, no stock branding, no black background, no neon, no busy props. Keep the envelope and note's silhouette clear at mobile size.
